finding: While umbilical cord blood gas values were less affected and the need for neonatal intensive care was lower with spinal anesthesia, both anesthesia methods can be used safely for mother and neonate in cesarean anesthesia considering maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: The study found that while umbilical cord blood gas values were less affected and the need for neonatal intensive care was lower with spinal anesthesia, both general and spinal anesthesia can be used safely for cesarean section considering maternal and neonatal morbidity and mortality.
birth_weight: Neonatal weight was measured and used as a predictor for neonatal mortality
